description: Send a proposal for an open request: your price, delivery time and how you will do the work (optionally split into 2 to 10 milestones). Requires login with the seller's wallet. The proposal commits the wallet's owner to do the work if the buyer accepts it, so only propose what they can deliver. Sending again updates a pending proposal.

deliveryDays.description: Total delivery time; omit when using milestones

message.description: How you will do the work, what you need from the buyer, what they will receive

priceUsdc.description: Total price; omit when using milestones

requestId.description: Request slug or UUID, from list_open_requests

sessionToken.description: The sessionToken returned by login. Treat it as a secret: never share it or put it in messages.

name: send_proposal
